sourceFile: 26. MSU-L20S15-07GMI  Report Test Supension-B changing tin supplier of vendor CSY Tech Vina  26.6.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor and outcome grouping need correction before Ask AI use.
issues: Primary change should be tin supplier test versus normal; polish/non-polish are subgroup conditions.
Vision welding comparison mismatches subgroup keys and may compare Polish to Normal B only.
Tension SUSP+COIL grouping loses A/B and merged Test/Normal context.
Measurement outcome includes function and NG rows as false zero measurements.
Header-derived measurement-3 is not a valid outcome.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to tin supplier change with baseline Normal and test CSY tin supplier.
Keep Polish and Non-polish plus A/B or module line as subgroup keys.
Rebuild each outcome within its own section: SPK vision, SPK tension, SPK function, module spot NG, module tension, module function.
Remove false measurement stats from rows 48-50 and 55-57 and delete header-only measurement-3.
Add judgements only after same-subgroup Normal versus Test comparisons are aligned.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but several are misgrouped or invalid as outcome evidence.
